name: masason-email-sweep
description: Check the Masason inbox for new deadlines and draft what is owed
tools: browseros-neo
---

## Steps
1. Open mail.google.com in BrowserOS neo
2. Read threads newer than the last run timestamp
3. Leave drafts unsent; report the list back in chat
